_doc: The living half of the MANIS-CUIRASS-001 page. The card's URL is burned into a chip and can never change, so this page is the only place depth can accumulate: someone who taps the card again next month should find something that was not here today. Adding an entry is a JSON edit and a deploy — never a new page and never a new URL. Newest first. Every number here is on the page above or is arithmetic on numbers that are; nothing here was measured off a built object, because nobody has built one.

entries.en: A2 is the drawing, not the shopping list
entries.body_en: The pattern prints on one A2 sheet, 594 × 420 mm, and tiles across A4 pages because no home printer takes A2. The material is a separate number: both faces of your card give the 0.6 m² of foam you need.
entries._audit_body_en: The sheet is A2, 594 × 420 mm. That is the size of the printed template, not the amount of foam — no home printer takes A2, so it tiles across A4. The material is a separate number, and both faces of your card give it: 0.6 m².

entries.en: At 97% the fit holds and the mantle shrinks
entries.body_en: Step 01 says a 97% print leaves every joint loose, but the tab and its slot shrink together, so the fit holds. What comes out 3% small is the mantle.
entries._audit_body_en: Step 01 says a 97% print leaves every joint loose. Both halves are on the same sheet, so both shrink: the 12 mm tab becomes 11.6 mm and the 12.4 mm slot 12.03 mm. The fit keeps its proportion — what comes out 3% small is the mantle.
